_about: The orbiter crew (docs/systems-and-items.md §10e, step 2 notes): the people meant to land with you, waiting in orbit until the finale. A working draft (7 Nov): the user will revisit names, roles and threads. Small crew = the first two; Standard = all five. voice, pitch, pace and link are as in data/mc_cast.json (tools/generate_voice.py), through the orbiter's link: a UHF radio a few hundred kilometres up, clearer than Earth's, a squelch at each end and no Quindar beeps. radio: lines spoken live, orb_<id>.wav; `at` is seconds into the descent phase, as a guide.

radio._about: The descent, talked down live (scripts/descent.gd). Each beat plays once, in order, when its phase is on and the voice is free; a phase that ends early skips the rest of its beats. 'lock', 'divert' and 'contact' are events; contact cuts in over anything and ends in static.

beats.speaker: rao
beats.text: Entry interface. You're glowing nicely. Hang on, this bit's loud.

beats.speaker: rao
beats.text: Chute's away, engines lit. Powered descent: pick your spot, I'll keep you honest.

beats.speaker: castellanos
beats.text: Base beacon's silent. So are the walkers. Nothing since the storm.

beats.speaker: castellanos
beats.text: You're coming in long, so forget the beacon. Your cameras will show you safe ground. Pick one.

beats.speaker: rao
beats.text: And I think I've got one. A parachute, on high ground. Picture when you're down.

beats.speaker: rao
beats.text: Fuel's getting thin. Choose your ground and commit.

lock.speaker: rao
lock.text: Locked. The computer has the last hundred metres. Hands off, breathe.

divert.speaker: rao
divert.text: Not there, it's too rough. The computer's moving you somewhere flatter.
